statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, abstract composition using bold geometric bands that continuously shift and reorganize across the canvas. The bands are rendered as polygonal forms with sharp edges and vibrant colors that transition through the HSB color space. Fine linear stripes traverse this geometric structure, adding further segmentation and movement. The entire composition operates autonomously, with no external interaction required, as the bands and stripes evolve through time-based noise functions that create organic yet structured motion. The visual aesthetic emphasizes rigid geometric relationships, contrasting color transitions, and a schematic energy that suggests an underlying lattice structure of intersecting forms.
